authority.statement: ESI-1 is the native deterministic source/symbol inventory used by --inventory. It does not grant MusicMutation, Writer, Repair, Selection or Release authority.

source_scope.scope_hash: SHA-256 over slash-normalized relative path + NUL + per-file SHA-256, ordered lexicographically

run_binding.project: PROJECT with exact project and current observation run_id
run_binding.corpus: CORPUS with current completed full-corpus manifest plus the current observation run_id used by all ten CMS-1 snapshots; corpus_manifest_run_id and observation run_id are distinct authorities and are both retained
run_binding.input_fingerprint: scope-specific SHA-256 projection of current project input fingerprints

projection.json: EtuSchlopf.inventory.json is the machine-readable native record
projection.xlsx: EtuSchlopf.inventory.xlsx is XLSX-1 projection of the same model
projection.assistant_export: both files are included iff --inventory produced them
projection.stale_current_artifacts: normal runs without --inventory remove current root inventory artifacts; assistant exports remain historical evidence

comparability.rule: ESI-1 source-inventory counts are directly comparable only when the ESI contract and source-scope semantics are equal; a future ESI-N contract is an explicit series break.
